title: Noise stability and agreement probabilities
statement: For every $\rho\in[-1,1]$ and every Boolean function $f$, its noise stability after interpreting its outputs as real signs equals the probability that its values agree on a correlated pair of inputs minus the probability that they disagree.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the Boolean cube
